name: "Doesn't untap during its controller's (next) untap step" is a trait — Claustrophobia, Choke, Frost Breath, Sleep, Abominable Treefolk, Amber Prison, Hold for Questioning
notes: A rule about untapping (CR 502.3) was read by nothing (2026-11-20): ~95 targeted units of the behavioural audit were skipped as one-shot ("Tap target creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step"), and Auras and statics (Claustrophobia, Choke) showed nothing. The rule block of cards-parser.js now keeps "Doesn't untap during <whose> [next] untap step" as a trait in the card's words: "their controllers' untap steps", "that player's" and "their" are said of one permanent as "its controller's", which _resolveTraitText names; how long it lasts ("for as long as this artifact remains tapped") and another clause after "and" (Hold for Questioning) are not the rule. The tap itself stays the player's (fired abilities never tap). Sleep's "Those creatures" are the creatures of the picked player.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Runeclaw Bear
scryfallData.flavor_text: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Ornithopter
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"It has been my honor to improve on Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

scryfallData.name: Claustrophobia
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

scryfallData.name: Choke
scryfallData.oracle_text: Islands don't untap during their controllers' untap steps.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"One day we shall walk where once was water."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

scryfallData.name: Frost Breath
scryfallData.oracle_text: Tap up to two target creatures. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "I'll make ice chimes of your bones."
